keyboard.behavior: Enter attempts one value; a configured separator splits typed/pasted input. Rejected Enter/blur attempts clear nonempty input.
Selects and focuses the last chip first; a subsequent delete removes selected chips unless a remove event is canceled.

keyboard.keys: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / Home / End on chips
keyboard.behavior: Moves real focus/selection through DOM order; Right past the last chip or End returns to the input. Shift extends a range.
Selects all chips; this is not an input-level select-all override.
From a chip: clears selection and focuses input. From input: clears input/selection and blurs it.

guidelines: Use getValues() for a copied array, not a .values property. A supplied ghost input needs a real label and a deliberate placeholder.
Chips has no automatic submitted array, live region, role=option or aria-selected synchronization. The JSON example and focus/contrast CSS are explicitly application-owned.
clear() removes all chips directly and emits change, bypassing per-chip remove cancellation. removeSelected() uses remove() and respects each veto.
Duplicate matching is case-sensitive. Initial seeded chips are initialized rather than revalidated against duplicates/maxChips; rejected Enter/blur attempts can discard the attempted text.
Generated dismiss buttons use aria-label=Remove and tabindex=-1; authored controls keep their own labels and tab order. The chip itself handles keyboard removal.
Native disabled input styling does not freeze existing-chip keyboard handlers or programmatic add/remove. dismissible=false is not read-only mode.
RTL changes layout but not physical ArrowLeft/Right DOM-index navigation. Do not advertise a roving ARIA listbox or automatic selection announcements.
Preserve approved icon sanitization and the duplicate-order removal fix. Dispose removes input listeners/base instance state, not generated markup or tabindex; callers own DOM cleanup.

definition.name: chips
methods: selectChip(chip: HTMLElement, options?: { addToSelection?: boolean; rangeSelect?: boolean; }): void

events.add.trm.chips: Cancelable wrapper event after trimming/duplicate/limit checks, before insertion. value and relatedTarget are direct event properties.
events.change.trm.chips: Wrapper notification after accepted add/remove or clear(), with a copied values array. Not a cancelable mutation gate or automatic form serialization.
events.remove.trm.chips: Cancelable wrapper event before remove(), with value, chip and relatedTarget. clear() bypasses this gate.
events.select.trm.chips: Wrapper selection notification with selected values. Clear/focus paths can emit an empty selection first; DOM mutation is not implied.

keyboard.behavior: Opens the Menu. Search focus is deferred to an animation frame when a search field exists.
Navigates enabled visible options with real focus. From a searchable trigger, deferred search focus can supersede the initial option focus; use ArrowDown from search.
Moves to first/last visible enabled option, including when pressed in search; not ordinary text-caret behavior.
Selects; single mode hides and focuses trigger, multiple mode keeps the Menu open.
Escape requests hide and focuses the trigger; Tab requests hide and follows native focus order. Cancellation can keep the Menu open.

guidelines: Put data-trm-toggle=combobox on a named native trigger, include combobox-value, and follow it with the actual Menu. The wrapper form-field is a layout helper, not an invented combobox CSS class.

Author labelled listbox/options and a separate labelled search input. Options receive real focus, not aria-activedescendant tracking. The pin binds any supplied search input even if search=false, and does not generate one from search=true.

Set data-trm-name for a generated hidden input. Single mode stores an identifier; multiple mode joins identifiers with commas. Validate delimiter-sensitive values and native form reset/disabled policies in your application.
There is no getValue/setValue API or free-text display/input contract. Initial selected items seed display and hidden value; labels/descriptions are not the submitted identifier.
The known owned-Menu registry notice is preserved. Combobox shown/hidden and returned promises do not await Menu transitions; observe shown.trm.menu/hidden.trm.menu for settled state.

Events expose value/item directly, not event.detail. change is post-mutation; only show/hide are read as cancellation gates. Outside dismissal may occur through Menu without Combobox hide/hidden notifications.
Use native disabled options; filtering can count their text while keyboard navigation excludes them. Group labels/no-results elements are authored, not generated or automatically regrouped.
Combobox has no own configurable Sass token map. It reuses form-control and Menu tokens; the sibling Menu rule sets max height 300px. The copied focus/contrast CSS is a demo choice, not a core patch.

events.change.trm.combobox: Trigger notification after updating selected classes, aria-selected, display and hidden input. value and item are direct event properties, not event.detail; preventing this event does not undo selection.
events.hidden.trm.combobox: Trigger notification after calling Menu hide(), not after its async transition. Observe Menu completion for settled visibility.
events.hide.trm.combobox: Cancelable trigger event before calling the owned Menu hide(). Outside dismissal may run through Menu directly.
events.show.trm.combobox: Cancelable trigger event before calling the owned Menu show().
events.shown.trm.combobox: Trigger notification immediately after calling Menu show(), before its transition or deferred search focus necessarily completes. Not proof a canceled Menu opened.
